description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSearchFilterParams class, which extends a FilterParams base class and includes traits for handling employee search filters within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides properties and methods to set and get various employee filtering criteria, including employee status, name, ID, and organizational subunits, along with validation logic for certain parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A class representing various filtering parameters for employee searches within the OrangeHRM PIM module, extending FilterParams and incorporating traits for subunit chain handling.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current setting for included employees (current, past, or both).

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion criteria for employees, with validation against predefined allowed values.

methods.description: Returns the name filter parameter.

methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers for filtering.
